children: Spot XRP ETFs drew $110.49 million in net inflows for the week ending August 28, their strongest weekly haul of 2026 and more than double the prior high, according to BeInCrypto, with trading volume hitting $363.03 million. Cumulative net inflows rose to $1.66 billion and total net assets climbed to $1.44 billion across the funds. XRP traded near $1.38 as of August 29, after briefly testing $1.70 resistance earlier in the week.

title: XRP ETFs Pull In $110.49 Million In Biggest Weekly Haul Of 2026
